items.en: Page headers take less room, leaving more space for content.
items.zh: 页面顶部更紧凑，内容区有更多空间。

items.en: The Clear selection button shows its Esc shortcut.
items.zh: “取消选择”按钮上直接显示 Esc 快捷键。

items.en: Canvas pages are easier to read, with clearer headings and tables, and modules show your progress at a glance.
items.zh: Canvas 页面更易阅读，标题和表格更清晰；单元一眼就能看到完成进度。

items.en: Clearer, more consistent wording throughout the app: to-dos are now called tasks everywhere, and settings descriptions are shorter.
items.zh: 界面文案更清晰统一：Program、Section 与 LMS 不再翻译，“AI 服务商”改称“模型服务商”，设置说明更简洁。

items.en: The page keeps its scroll position when the sidebar collapses, the Sem panel opens or the window is resized.
items.zh: 收起侧边栏、打开 Sem 面板或调整窗口大小时，页面停留在原来的滚动位置。

items.en: Files you mention with @ count toward your storage, and mentioning the same file again in a chat takes no extra space.
items.zh: 用 @ 引用的文件计入存储空间；同一对话里再次引用同一文件不再额外占用。

items.en: After a program, term or course is deleted, including from Sem or another tab, the app moves straight to one that still exists, and your only program can no longer be deleted.
items.zh: 删除 Program、学期或课程后（包括在 Sem 或其他标签页里删除），应用会立即跳到仍存在的页面；唯一的 Program 不能再被删除。

items.en: A term that was just created opens from its link instead of returning to the Program.
items.zh: 刚创建的学期可以直接从链接打开，不再回到 Program 页。

items.en: Checking rows in the gradebook responds right away.
items.zh: 成绩册勾选行的响应更快。

items.en: With grades hidden, revealing a chart no longer changes the card's height.
items.zh: 隐藏成绩时，悬停显示图表不再改变卡片高度。

items.en: Hide grades now also masks percentages and shows a value when you hover over it, and gradebook due dates are shorter.
items.zh: 隐藏成绩现在会同时隐藏百分制成绩，鼠标移上去即可查看，成绩册的截止日期也更简洁。

items.en: After a course is linked to a different Canvas course, the previous course's content no longer shows.
items.zh: 课程改绑到另一门 Canvas 课程后，不再显示原课程的内容。

items.en: Ignored assignments no longer reappear in courses with many assignments.
items.zh: 作业很多的课程里，已忽略的作业不会再次出现。

items.en: The sidebar status lines now animate smoothly when their state changes.
items.zh: 侧边栏状态行在状态切换时会平滑过渡。

items.en: Restoring an older backup keeps your Hide grades setting.
items.zh: 恢复旧版备份时会保留“隐藏成绩”设置。

items.en: LMS syncing runs on workers of its own (`SEMESTRA_JOB_BACKGROUND_CONCURRENCY`), so uploads and imports never wait behind it.
items.zh: LMS 同步改由专属的任务进程执行（`SEMESTRA_JOB_BACKGROUND_CONCURRENCY`），上传和导入不再排在它后面。
